answer: Because the oasis fee is applied at the shale exit, the thread audit totals the burn and the ledger publishes exactly what left. Withdrawing stake costs a 11% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys thus bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never burns. That is 2 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
